items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 6.8.2 at source lines 953-957: for every type E the canonical map sending t : A sqcup^C B -> E to the cocone (t o inl, t o inr, mapfunc{t} o glue) is an equivalence with cocone(D,E). The author's 52-line proof (source lines 958-1009) is a concrete quasi-inverse construction rather than a citation: the inverse s(c) is defined by the pushout's recursion principle on the three generators inl, inr and glue (lines 971-976), and the two round trips live in different types, one in cocone(D,E) and one in a function type into E, so each has to be checked separately. The first round trip (lines 981-994) is a four-step computation that ends only at the definitional equality (i,j,h); the second (lines 996-1006) requires comparing two functions on all three constructors, and the glue case is precisely where the recursion computation rule mapfunc{s(c)}(glue(x)) = h(x) is consumed. Nothing in the statement records that the two directions are the two different comparisons.
